statement: The owner accepted E27c as the new baseline after reviewing the three suites, the protocol-2 interference phase and the four-simultaneous-32K diagnostic against E27 and E27b.
accepted_trade_off: Queued long prompts wait for the cadence (last of four simultaneous 32K prompts about +7% time to first token; cold prefill and replay 1-3% below the frozen E27 medians, within the spread between the functionally identical E27b and E27c loads) in exchange for C4 per-stream TTFT -27% against E27 and the first of several simultaneous long contexts decoding at about 12 tok/s instead of 6.
follow_up: Smaller prefill chunks, or a longer interval, while others decode, to raise the first stream beyond about 12 tok/s.
